prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity Chinese strategy RPG game interface design target, 16:9 landscape 2048x1152. This is ONE full desktop screen, not a contact sheet. Game 风云南北朝, historical crisis negotiation screen. Art direction: southern and northern dynasties, parchment and dark pine-green ink, worn thin bronze-gold borders and brushstroke edges, refined Chinese line-and-wash historical illustration, elegant readable Chinese Song typography. Muted campaign map visible around a centered large parchment dialog. Match the established paper and ink style of the reference image in the conversation, but create new composition. No software dashboard cards, no rounded pills, no progress bar for rebellion, no fantasy armor. Header ink-brush title “河南来书”, small subtitle “归附请求 · 待你裁定”. Narrow illustrated banner of envoy presenting a sealed letter in a southern court, upper fifth only. Left 24%: fine flat watercolor half-length portrait of middle-aged Hou Jing in historically inspired dark armor, text “侯景” “东魏将领 · 驻颍川”, small location link “查看人物与部曲”. Right large main area: text “侯景请求携部曲归附。是否接纳，由你裁定。” Below three equal-width selectable paper tiles with radio states and tiny painted scenes, exact labels “保留部曲” selected, “逐步改编”, “只纳个人”; under each short consequences “保留个人军权”, “需按约完成改编”, “不接收独立军队”. Below a dark green consequence inset with bright cream lettering, title “接纳后果” and clearly legible rows “梁中央公库支出 100 钱” “接收实际追随兵团，留守者不转投” “当前两国和平：接纳后进入保护战争”. Beneath an amber paper warning “修改条款须侯景同意，发出还价不会立即接纳。” Footer fixed and visible: left outline button “拒绝接纳”, center small text “原案：保留部曲”, right muted gold button “确认按原案接纳”. No close X or “知道了”. Above the game's frame, a small design-review caption “预期效果 · 待确认｜示意场景，非实机”. Do not add fake exact troop counts or success probability. All Chinese text sharp and exact, restrained decoration, all controls fully on screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Make a beautiful Chinese historical strategy game UI design board, 2 panels horizontally, 3:2 landscape high resolution. Each panel is a complete independent parchment window over a subtly dim ink-green campaign map. Top outer caption “预期效果 · 待确认｜示意场景，非实机”. Southern northern dynasties, fine flat Chinese line and watercolor illustration, off-white paper, dark ink brush borders, old gold selection strokes, Song typography with bold calligraphic headers. Left panel: crisis dossier headed “寿春疑云”, narrow painted river-fortress banner, small subtitle “降将安置 · 当前交涉”. A compact row of two square portraits “侯景” and “朝廷执政者”, followed by a clear paper status box “当前争议” “军中欠饷尚未补齐” “归附约定：保留部曲”. Three horizontal timeline rows with seal markers “来书 · 请求接纳”, “安置 · 双方已立约”, “交涉 · 欠饷待处理”; show past and present only, no future chapters. Main action tiles icon+title “筹措军饷” “重议兵权” “查看部曲”. Bottom ink strip “处理窗口尚余 18 日” and secondary explanation “届期重新评估，不代表必然起兵”. One bottom outline button “返回地图”. Top map area a small compact vertical paper flag “交涉 / 18日”, visibly clickable, no tooltip.
Right panel: wartime dossier headed “建康告急”, painted narrow city-under-siege banner. Subtitle “侯景之乱 · 围城军报”. Single row icon tabs “局势” selected, “经过”, “人物”. A concise three-row readable report “建康 · 围城中” “粮情 · 告急” “援军 · 在途”, each with small matching icon. Below message “你以地方官身份阅报，只能调动有权军队与公粮。” Two equal paper illustrated action cards “调遣军队” and “军粮接济”, a disabled third smaller action “裁定议降” with visible reason “须由城内守城主官裁定”. Link “查看围城与援军”. Fixed footer single outline button “返回地图”. No fake relief timers, no probability, no extra gold execute button because these cards open real action dialogs, no known future spoilers. Visual hierarchy compact and playable, painted banners never take more than 20% height.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity Chinese historical strategy RPG design board, TWO complete UI panels side by side, landscape 3:2. Outer small caption “预期效果 · 待确认｜示意场景，非实机”. Refined southern northern dynasties ink-brush parchment game aesthetics, dark pine-green ink, warm ivory textured paper, antique gold fine-line borders, flat Chinese fine-line watercolor figures not 3D, readable Chinese typography. Left panel is person detail window: left third tall full bust/standing portrait of aging statesman Gao Huan wearing dark northern court robes, preserve 2:3 portrait proportions; right two-thirds identity “高欢” and row “50 岁｜热病·重症｜延医中”. One row small icon+label tabs “总览” selected “家族” “互动”. Main compact section “身体与安排”, separated readable rows “病情：重症，暂不能远行” “照料：延医照料仍有效” “军政安排：尚待处理” “家业继任：尚未指定”. No lifespan meter or death probability. A highlighted paper sentence “延医可改善病情，不能消除自然衰老。” Four small icon+text action tiles with same size “伤病休养” “家业继任” “军政交接” “养护安排”. Bottom dark inset health example, smaller “萧衍｜82 岁｜康健｜高龄” and “暂无明显病伤，仍需考虑身后安排”. A clear top corner close X is allowed in this person detail.
Right panel is historical decision headed “病榻议事”, narrow watercolor bedroom council banner with old statesman and two advisers, small label “北方生变 · 待你裁定”. Body “病势未稳，近臣请议军政安排。侯景的兵权与待遇，也需要明确答复。” Three paper radio options in vertical stack, first selected with old-gold border and check: “准备军政交接” with subtext “前往朝廷，选择合法接任安排”； second “重申原有待遇” with subtext “按真实权限与成本确认”； third “继续亲自掌权” with subtext “不交出权力，未解矛盾仍会保留”. Bottom dark green inset with cream lettering “当前选择只进入交接安排，尚未移交权力。” Gold footer button “前往朝廷安排”. No close button for this decision, no countdown to death, no guaranteed death date. Entire design has coherent existing-game style, not a webpage infographic.

revisions.prompt: Edit this design board with only these corrections. Preserve the two-panel composition, all functional controls, paper/green/gold colors and all other Chinese copy. On left portrait replace “北魏权臣” with “东魏执政者”, do not label him emperor. Change Gao Huan's clothing and face rendering to flatter refined Chinese ink line and light watercolor wash, wearing simple dark northern court robes; remove the elaborate gold armor, fur warrior costume, photoreal shading and oversized ornamental crown. Keep the portrait confined to its existing left 2:3 column. Remove the decorative invented mottos at the lower left portrait and outer bottom corners. The Xiao Yan card is a separate alternative HEALTH STATE EXAMPLE, not an entry in Gao Huan's personal health: add the exact small clear label above it “同布局状态示例”. Keep title “病榻议事”, age/illness line and all buttons legible and unchanged. Keep outer caption “预期效果 · 待确认｜示意场景，非实机”.
revisions.reason: 修正东魏身份、人物服饰和替代状态示例标签
